detail.longDescription: I am trying to program a custom topology in Mininet using the below python code. The topology consists of 4 routers, 2 switches, and 2 hosts. See below for a diagram of the network topology. Each router represents a different network and all network should be reachable from each of the routers. I am trying to get all routers and hosts respond to pings from every other router/host using the pingall command in Mininet. What I expect: h1 -> h2 r1 r2 r3 r4 h2 -> h1 r1 r2 r3 r4 r1 -> h1 h2 r2 r3 r4 r2 -> h1 h2 r2 r3 r4 r3 -> h1 h2 r1 r2 r4 r4 -> h1 h2 r1 r2 r3 *** Results: 0% dropped (30/30 received) But for some reason pingall keeps failing and some devices are either not being reached or taking to long too long and stalling. The code is: from mininet.topo import Topo from mininet.net import Mininet from mininet.node import Node from mininet.log import setLogLevel, info from mininet.cli import CLI class LinuxRouter(Node): def config(self, **params): super(LinuxRouter, self).config(**params) # Enable forwarding on the router self.cmd('sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=1') def terminate(self): self.cmd('sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=0') super(LinuxRouter, self).terminate() class NetworkTopo(Topo): def build(self, **_opts): # Add 4 routers in four different subnets r1 = self.addHost('r1', cls=LinuxRouter, ip='10.0.1.1/24') r2 = self.addHost('r2', cls=LinuxRouter, ip='10.0.2.1/24') r3 = self.addHost('r3', cls=LinuxRouter, ip='10.0.3.1/24') r4 = self.addHost('r4', cls=LinuxRouter, ip='10.0.4.1/24') # Add 2 switches s1 = self.addSwitch('s1') s2 = self.addSwitch('s2') # Add hosts h1 = self.addHost('h1', ip='10.0.1.10/24', defaultRoute='via 10.0.1.1') h2 = self.addHost('h2', ip='10.0.4.10/24', defaultRoute='via 10.0.4.1') # Add host-switch links self.addLink(h1, s1) self.addLink(h2, s2) # Add switch-router links self.addLink(s1, r1, intfName2='r1-eth1', params2={'ip': '10.0.1.1/24'}) self.addLink(s2, r4, intfName2='r4-eth1', params2={'ip': '10.0.4.1/24'}) # Add router-router links self.addLink(r1, r2, intfName1='r1-eth2', intfName2='r2-eth2', params1={'ip': '10.100.1.2/24'}, params2={'ip': '10.100.2.1/24'}) self.addLink(r1, r3, intfName1='r1-eth3', intfName2='r3-eth2', params1={'ip': '10.100.1.3/24'}, params2={'ip': '10.100.3.1/24'}) self.addLink(r1, r4, intfName1='r1-eth4', intfName2='r4-eth2', params1={'ip': '10.100.1.4/24'}, params2={'ip': '10.100.4.1/24'}) self.addLink(r2, r4, intfName1='r2-eth3', intfName2='r4-eth3', params1={'ip': '10.100.2.4/24'}, params2={'ip': '10.100.4.2/24'}) self.addLink(r3, r4, intfName1='r3-eth3', intfName2='r4-eth4', params1={'ip': '10.100.3.4/24'}, params2={'ip': '10.100.4.3/24'}) def run(): topo = NetworkTopo() net = Mininet(topo=topo) # Add routing for reaching networks that aren't directly connected info(net['r1'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.2.0/24 via 10.100.1.2')) info(net['r1'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.3.0/24 via 10.100.1.3')) info(net['r1'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.4.0/24 via 10.100.1.4')) info(net['r2'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.1.0/24 via 10.100.2.1')) info(net['r2'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.3.0/24 via 10.100.2.1')) info(net['r2'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.4.0/24 via 10.100.2.4')) info(net['r3'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.1.0/24 via 10.100.3.1')) info(net['r3'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.4.0/24 via 10.100.3.4')) info(net['r4'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.1.0/24 via 10.100.4.1')) info(net['r4'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.2.0/24 via 10.100.4.2')) info(net['r4'].cmd('ip route add 10.0.3.0/24 via 10.100.4.3')) # Add routing for reaching back to networks that sent the packet info(net['r1'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.2.0/24 via 10.100.1.2')) info(net['r1'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.3.0/24 via 10.100.1.3')) info(net['r1'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.4.0/24 via 10.100.1.4')) info(net['r2'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.1.0/24 via 10.100.2.1')) info(net['r2'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.4.0/24 via 10.100.2.4')) info(net['r3'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.1.0/24 via 10.100.3.1')) info(net['r3'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.2.0/24 via 10.100.3.1')) info(net['r3'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.4.0/24 via 10.100.3.4')) info(net['r4'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.1.0/24 via 10.100.4.1')) info(net['r4'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.2.0/24 via 10.100.4.2')) info(net['r4'].cmd('ip route add 10.100.3.0/24 via 10.100.4.3')) net.start() CLI(net) net.stop() if __name__ == '__main__': setLogLevel('info') run() the actual result of running pingall is: h1 -> X r1 X X X h2 -> X X X X r4 r1 -> h1 X X X r4 r2 -> X X X X r4 r3 -> X X X X r4 r4 -> X h2 r1 r2 r3 *** Results: 66% dropped (10/30 received) the topology is: What am I doing wrong that my network is not responding as it should? Any assistance to get all systems to ping all others would be appreciated.
